references.text: The tribe of Reuben asks to receive the land east of the Jordan as their inheritance, which is the background for the boundary description in Joshua 13:23.
Describes the cities that Reuben's sons built, corresponding to the inheritance mentioned in Joshua 13:23.
Moses gives a summary of the land given to Reuben, with the Jordan as its border, as confirmed in Joshua 13:23.
The detailed description of Reuben's inheritance that comes just before verse 23, which verse 23 summarizes.
Reuben's sons return to their inheritance east of the Jordan, which was assigned to them according to Joshua 13:23.
Ezekiel's future land distribution mentions Reuben and shows the continuity of the tribe's inheritance.
